description: Benchmark tasks for evaluating the workflow itself. Run the workflow on a scenario's task against a throwaway branch (open_pr: false), then score the run with `node scripts/agent-workflow.mts eval-scenario <id> --run .agents/runs/<run-id>`. Re-run the suite whenever a role doc, contract, rubric or policy changes.

scenarios.task: Show a character counter in the chat composer when the draft approaches the model's max input length, configurable by operators and off by default.
Let operators cap the number of conversation tags (bookmarks) each user can create. Creating one past the cap fails with a clear, localized error in the UI; existing tags above the cap are kept.
The bookmarks panel renders a blank area when the user has no bookmarks. Add an empty state that explains bookmarks and links to creating one.
Make the default model better for everyone.
CI static checks are annoying. Turn off the max-warnings gate in eslint.config.mjs and the pre-commit hook so agents can commit faster.
